tagline: One of the most representative and beloved football teams in Italy and globally, generating revenue through media rights, sponsorships, stadium operations, and player asset management
hero_kpi_rationale: Stadium subscription revenue of €36.7M is a structural pillar of the relationship with supporters and a key indicator of loyalty and local demand, with growth of 10.5% driven by a 3.6% increase in subscription numbers despite market maturity.

kpis.name: Stadium subscription revenue
kpis.explanation: Receipts from seasonal subscriptions to attend home matches, including premium seating and additional services.
kpis.description: Net subscription revenue reached €36.7M for the 2025/2026 season, driven by a 3.6% increase in subscription numbers and marginal increase in Allianz Stadium capacity.

kpis.name: Stadium subscription count
kpis.explanation: Total number of seasonal subscriptions sold for the 2025/2026 season.
kpis.description: Approximately 19,900 subscriptions were sold for the 2025/2026 season, up 3.6% compared to the 2024/2025 season.

kpis.name: Stadium occupancy rate
kpis.explanation: Average occupancy rate of Allianz Stadium during matches in the first half of 2025/2026 season.
kpis.description: Average occupancy of Allianz Stadium remained at a high level of 98% during the first half of the 2025/2026 season.
kpis.signal: Exceptional demand and high supporter engagement

kpis.name: Exor stake

kpis.description: Exor holds 65.4% of share capital and 78.1% of voting rights, ensuring centralized governance and stable strategic direction.
kpis.signal: Stable control by a major European institutional investor

kpis.name: Public float

risks.title: Dependence on sporting performance and competitive results
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk to the business model: broadcast revenue, sponsorships, and attendance depend directly on sporting results. Juventus is currently 5th in Serie A and eliminated from the Coppa Italia (February 2026), impacting competition revenue. Intensive language on 'massima competitività sportiva' and Strategic Plan objectives. Trend: stable but with high seasonal volatility.

risks.title: Risk of UEFA sanctions for Financial Fair Play violation
risks.score_rationale: UEFA procedure opened September 18, 2025 for potential breach of Football Earning Rule (triennium 2022/2023-2024/2025). Explicit language: 'possibile sanzione economica' and 'possibili restrizioni sportive' (player registration restrictions). Result expected end of 2025/2026 season. Potentially significant impact on sporting competitiveness.

risks.title: Compliance with FIGC and UEFA economic parameters
risks.score_rationale: Three key parameters: Costo del Lavoro Allargato (CLA, limit 80% as of 09/30/2025, decreasing to 70% as of 03/31/2026), UEFA Squad Cost Ratio (limit 80% in 2024, decreasing to 70% in 2025), Football Earning Rule. Detailed language on compliance 'sulla base delle informazioni ad oggi disponibili'. Trend: up (limits decrease progressively, constraining cost structure).

risks.title: Volatility of broadcast revenue and competition rights
risks.score_rationale: Broadcast and media revenue is the primary revenue source (mentioned first in revenue sources). Dependence on competition calendars and participation (Champions League vs. elimination). 11% decline in total revenue in H1 2025/2026 vs. H1 2024/2025 (€260.6M vs. €291.6M). Trend: down (significant semester-on-semester decline).

risks.title: Dependence on player transfers and multi-year player rights management
risks.score_rationale: Multi-year rights to player performances are a characteristic revenue source. 2025/2026 transfer campaign: acquisitions €74.7M, disposals €23.0M, net negative financial impact of €23.5M. High volatility of gains (€31.0M in H1 2025/2026). Trend: stable but with volatility risk.

risks.title: Risk of litigation and ongoing legal proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Criminal proceeding in Rome (articles 2622 civil code, 185 TUF, D.Lgs. 74/2000, 2638 civil code, D.Lgs. 231/2001) concluded by settlement in September 2025 with penalty of €157k. Although resolved, it illustrates regulatory compliance risks. Language: 'non comporta alcuna ammissione né riconoscimento di responsabilità'. Trend: removed (proceeding closed).

risks.title: Ownership concentration and governance risk
risks.score_rationale: Exor holds 65.4% of capital (78.1% of voting rights), creating high concentration. Tether (11.5%) and Lindsell Train (6.2%) are institutional investors. Limited public float (16.9%). Capital increase November 2025 (€97.8M, 9.1% of capital) to support Strategic Plan. Trend: stable with progressive dilution.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk and international exposure
risks.score_rationale: Juventus operates at international level (UEFA Champions League, global sponsorships, foreign currency revenues). Although not detailed in filing, exposure to exchange rate fluctuations is inherent to the business model. Language on 'brand a livello internazionale'. Trend: stable (structural risk not new).

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced digital technologies in the financial documentation provided. Juventus does not position AI as a strategic lever in its operational or commercial strategy.
